settings_ui_archive_hint: Capture archive preference only. Rust live capture is not connected; offline import retains its fixed 172 MiB archive / 156 MiB expanded safety limits. Findings filtering applies once rule results are available.
settings_ui_device_required: Choose a device and target in the title bar, or enter the target in CPU capture.
settings_ui_engine_hint: Rust is the active engine. The Compose Legacy adapters are not linked into this independent app.
settings_ui_guide_body: 1. Select the target in the title bar.  2. Choose a template or edit event, frequency/period, duration, call graph and scope.  3. Open CPU capture, inspect the frozen plan, then explicitly confirm. Settings and CPU capture share one draft. Changing a setting never starts capture or edits an existing plan.
settings_ui_hex_error: Use RGB, RRGGBB or AARRGGBB. The applied color was not changed.
settings_ui_sdk_error: The SDK must be an absolute directory with a usable platform-tools/adb executable.
settings_ui_sdk_hint: Choose an SDK directory containing an executable platform-tools/adb. Applies to future target discovery and captures; running operations keep their current ADB.
settings_ui_semantic_navigation_hint: Experimental. Launches a local language server (JDT LS, Kotlin LSP or clangd) for go-to-definition and find usages. Servers can use hundreds of MB of memory; source text never leaves this machine.
settings_ui_semantic_navigation_warning: Enable semantic navigation? A local language server process will be started and may use hundreds of MB of memory.
settings_ui_show_system_composables_hint: Shows Composables marked by inspection as system-created, including common layout nodes such as Box, Row, and Column. Turn it off to hide those nodes and reduce hierarchy noise. The setting takes effect on the next capture or refresh.
settings_ui_viewer_hint: Only the native Local viewer is connected. Firefox viewer adapters are not available in this app.
settings_ui_sampling_template_descriptio: Choose a starting point for Simpleperf capture.
settings_ui_advanced_parameters_descript: Tune call graph collection and event scope.
settings_ui_frame_information_descriptio: Choose how frame information follows pointer movement.
settings_ui_frame_information_behavior: Keep the Firefox-style frame details fixed in the corner or follow the mouse pointer.
settings_ui_analysis_engine_description: Choose where captured Simpleperf data is analyzed.
settings_ui_analysis_engine_options: Choose the new engine, the pinned local Firefox Profiler site, or the official Firefox Profiler website.
settings_ui_user_guide_description: Read the offline Simpleperf user guide in your default browser.
settings_ui_template_ui_thread_focus_des: High-frequency sampling for a selected UI thread.
settings_ui_template_native_hotspot_desc: CPU cycle sampling for native computation hotspots.
settings_ui_template_low_overhead_descri: Reduced frequency with frame-pointer call graphs.
settings_ui_template_system_process_desc: Conservative sampling for a root-accessible system process.
settings_ui_sampling_target_required: Select a target to configure sampling parameters.
settings_ui_capture_parameters_connect: Select a device and process in the title bar, or enter a target in CPU capture. Flame graph and engine preferences remain available.
settings_ui_adapters_not_connected: Available events have not been queried. Event names can be entered directly.
